purpose: Each level of the design must stay small enough to read whole. This records lint.toml's docs budget. cargo xtask lint enforces the budget and fails when this record disagrees with it.
requirement: Each directory under docs/, docs/ included, holds at most 5,500 words in the .md files directly inside it. A subdirectory's words count only toward its own budget, so when a directory is full, detail moves into a subdirectory. Raise the budget only in a change that says why.
